common: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone full-body Korean adult in their 20s. Reference image 1 is the approved FEMALE face/style master; reference image 2 is approved MALE face/style master. Use the relevant body silhouette but keep facial features IDENTICAL across characters: same small dark eyes slightly open with tiny sclera at corners, no shiny pupil highlights, same nose/mouth placement and calm natural expression. No cute large anime eyes. Match exactly the reference coarse square-pixel art, visible large logical pixels, thin dark ONE logical-pixel outline, ordinary adult body proportions with relatively small head. Full-body FRONT VIEW standing straight, arms relaxed down, centered on EXACT 1:2 canvas, target 887x1774 matching masters, complete hair and shoes inside generous transparent margins. TRUE transparent alpha background, no green fringe, shadow, floor, white border, letters or watermark. Deliberately MINIMAL DETAIL and only ONE flat shadow level. STRICTLY at most EIGHT flat opaque colors per character (reuse skin/cream, dark hair/outline, gray/navy/beige/khaki/denim colors as needed), muted natural colors. Coarse approx 80x160 logical pixels with sharp nearest-neighbor square pixel blocks. No antialiasing, gradients, blur, soft texture, realistic fabric, tiny stitching details, excess folds. No pastel-only scheme, ribbons, sparkles, stars, animal ears, decorative accessories unless explicitly listed. Hairstyle, hair color and outfit MUST change to specified character; do not retain reference hair or outfit. All characters share the SAME facial features. PNG.
